Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human TYK2. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_structures. Filter by target name 'TYK2' and organism 'Homo sapiens', and by standard_type 'IC50'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
